name: Unfaithfulness
overview: Scripture clearly condemns unfaithfulness, particularly adultery, as a grievous sin that destroys the soul and warrants severe judgment, as seen in Exodus 20:14 and Leviticus 20:10. Proverbs emphasizes the lack of understanding in committing adultery and the personal ruin it brings (Proverbs 6:32). Furthermore, God's knowledge of the heart and just judgment is highlighted in Proverbs 24:11-12, reminding believers that hidden sins will be accounted for. Isaiah 5:1 uses the metaphor of a vineyard to illustrate God's relationship with His people, underscoring the expectation of faithfulness and fruitfulness.
